ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, approximately 1:12 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base with high-contrast white clusters at the distal tips. A prominent vertical white streak is located slightly left of the median notch. Small, high-intensity white speckles are non-uniformly distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge. Serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-intensity pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-region of both lobes, appearing as white-on-black spots.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical white linear disruptions on the lower-center of the right lobe and a single prominent vertical mark near the center-left notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity white scarring on the trailing edge and distal tip of the right lobe. Significant white pigmentation patch on the leading edge tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: White water turbulence/foam occludes the insertion point of the fluke at the peduncle base.
